rationale: Nathanaël brings deep embedded systems and hardware-software integration expertise (Python, MATLAB, VHDL) that directly complements Rahul's early-stage hardware development work at Copa. As a CTO with IoT background, Nathanaël could offer valuable technical guidance on the hardware architecture and integration challenges that smart sanitation solutions typically face.
intro_message: Nathanaël BLAVO-BALLARIN, meet Rahul N Rachamalla — Rahul is building Copa, a smart sanitation hardware product, and your CTO experience with embedded systems and hardware-software integration could be a useful sounding board as he scales the technical architecture.
